title: Dataset Watermarking with Provable Black-Box Detection
abstract: arXiv:2605.06865v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are often pre-trained and post-trained on vast amounts of loosely curated data, and potentially have been trained on proprietary datasets or the benchmarks used for evaluation. This motivates dataset watermarking: designing datasets such that training on them leaves detectable signatures in the resulting model. Existing approaches embed watermarks by either injecting artificial content or paraphrasing full examples under token-level generation control, and many require model access beyond generated outputs for detection. Our method embeds a dataset-level watermark by increasing the co-occurrence of randomly selected word pairs through meaning-preserving local edits, and detects it from generated text alone with provable false positive control. translated_title: 具有可证明黑盒检测的数据集水印技术
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型通常在海量粗略整理的数据上进行预训练和后训练，甚至可能在专有数据集或用于评估的基准测试上进行了训练。这推动了数据集水印技术的发展：即通过精心设计数据集，使得在其上进行训练会在所得模型中留下可检测的印记。现有方法要么通过注入人工内容，要么在token级生成控制下改写完整样本来嵌入水印，且许多方法在检测时需要访问生成输出之外的模型内部信息。我们的方法通过保持语义的局部编辑来增加随机选择词对的共现频率，从而嵌入数据集级别的水印，并且仅凭生成的文本即可检测水印，同时提供可证明的假阳性控制。我们在四个基础模型和三个数据集上进行了评估，结果表明该方法在微调阶段能够可靠地检测到水印（p < 0.01），性能优于现有方法。
tldr: 该论文提出一种通过保持语义的局部编辑增加随机词对共现来嵌入数据集水印的方法，仅凭模型生成文本即可实现具有可证明假阳性控制的黑盒检测。
en_tdlr: Proposes a dataset watermarking method that embeds watermarks by increasing the co-occurrence of randomly selected word pairs through meaning-preserving local edits, enabling black-box detection from generated text alone with provable false positive control.
